noeuds.role: Tests a condition: follows the True output if it is right, False otherwise. “Then” runs afterwards, in both cases.

noeuds.schema: Outputs: Up / Down / Left / Right / Idle / Then
noeuds.role: Follows the output matching the joystick direction: Up, Down, Left, Right, or Idle when it is not touched.
noeuds.exemple: linked to “Every frame” to play the walking animation in the right direction.

noeuds.role: True if the bottom of the object is standing on a fixed, visible object (floor, platform), False otherwise.
noeuds.exemple: only allow jumping when the player is on the ground.

noeuds.role: True if the object moved since the previous frame, False otherwise.
noeuds.exemple: play the walking animation only when the character moves.

noeuds.role: Runs a function (a Blueprint created in the Functions section), then continues. Do not put it under “Every frame”.
noeuds.exemple: a “LoseLife” function used by several enemies.

noeuds.role: Runs the “Local Event” with this name, in the same Blueprint, then continues.
noeuds.exemple: call “GameOver” from the fall and from the timer.

noeuds.role: Runs its outputs one after the other: 1, then 2, then 3, then 4. An output with no link is skipped.
noeuds.exemple: at start: 1 = place the player, 2 = start the music, 3 = show the score.

noeuds.role: Lets things through “Ready” at most once per delay (in seconds); otherwise it is “Not yet”. With an object chosen, each object has its own delay.
noeuds.exemple: shoot at most once every 0.5 second.

noeuds.role: True if the object is completely off the screen (plus the margin), False otherwise.
noeuds.exemple: destroy bullets that leave the screen.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: If (condition), Else if (condition)  →  Outputs: If / Else if / Else / Then
noeuds.role: Tests the first condition, then the second: follows “If”, “Else if” or “Else”. “Then” runs afterwards.
noeuds.exemple: if score >= 100 → gold, else if score >= 50 → silver, else → bronze.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Value to test, Case 1, Case 2, Case 3, Case 4, Case 5, Case 6  →  Outputs: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / None / Then
noeuds.role: Compares the value to test with cases 1 to 6 and follows the output of the first matching case; “None” if nothing matches. An empty case is skipped.
